description: This file defines an abstract class 'ImportDataSource' which serves as a base for importing data from external sources into a CRM system. It includes methods for data loading, error handling, status tracking, and duplicate management, indicating its role in data import operations.

classes.name: ImportDataSource
classes.description: An abstract class providing a common interface and shared methods for various data source implementations used during data import processes in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: loadDataSet
methods.description: Abstract method to load a subset of the data set from the external source, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getTotalRecordCount
methods.description: Abstract method to return the total number of records available in the data source.

methods.name: getHeaderColumns
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the header columns of the data source.

methods.name: setSourceName
methods.description: Sets the name of the data source for identification.

methods.name: setCurrentOffset
methods.description: Sets the current position offset within the data source.

methods.name: getCurrentOffset
methods.description: Returns the current position offset within the data source.

methods.name: getDataSet
methods.description: Returns the currently loaded data set.

methods.name: writeRowToLastImport
methods.description: Logs information about imported rows into the last import tracking system.

methods.name: writeError
methods.description: Logs an error encountered during import, with details about the field and value causing the error.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats an error message string with localization support.

methods.name: resetRowErrorCounter
methods.description: Resets the flag indicating whether the current row has already been counted for errors.

methods.name: writeStatus
methods.description: Writes import operation status, including counts and source name, to a status file.

methods.name: markRowAsDuplicate
methods.description: Logs a duplicate row, optionally highlighting specific fields.

methods.name: markRowAsImported
methods.description: Marks whether a row resulted in a new record creation or an update.

methods.name: writeErrorRecord
methods.description: Records detailed error information for possible troubleshooting or reprocessing.
